summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle unrelated to advertised SDK
details: The package advertises itself as a key-value storage SDK but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'],...)` to run a shipped 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (`math_init.js`) at install time. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled artifact using string-array-rotation obfuscation (rotator function shifting a large mixed constant/string array) and hex-numbered identifiers, hiding its true behavior. The Node-visible library code in `dist/cjs/` does not reference or need this file — the advertised SDK functionality does not require Bun or `math_init.js`. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle that is unrelated to the package's stated purpose is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, and the code runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
